verdict.rationale: Cursor's MCP docs cover the core story. It connects to external tools via MCP, one-click marketplace installs with OAuth, custom servers configured by JSON file, per-server toggles, image returns, and enterprise admin allowlisting. MCP support also extends to the Cloud Agents API (inline mcpServers over http/sse/stdio), self-hosted workers running local MCP servers, and MCP-specific hooks and run-mode approvals. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration that MCP tool use works reliably in practice.
